answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. What survives to the tundra is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. A delta of per-task receipts records who did what, and the mirror of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
